title: PARTY RUN GOALS KEEP THEIR PROGRESS WHEN THE HOST LEAVES
why: His ruling: when the host is gone the remaining player picks up the raid, and since v27.27 the run goals are the party's: the host counts them and player 2 shows the host's progress. At the takeover player 2's window starts counting the goals itself again, but from its own counts only, so the party progress fell back to player 2's own: 10 KILLS at 7 of 10 on the host became 3 of 10 (his own 3 kills), and 3 WAVES and AIR STRIKE fell the same way. Proven in a staged pair (host 7 kills sent in the world word, player 2 with 3 of his own, the real netHostGone, then the goal tick): 3 of 10 after the takeover. Now at the takeover each goal not yet done keeps the gap between the party progress and this window's own count, and the goal tick adds it back, so it stays 7 of 10 and 3 more kills finish it.
now: If your host leaves mid raid, the run goals keep the progress you made together instead of dropping back to only your own kills.
